annotations.title: OrbitWan premium data: how to pay

description: Free. Returns the live payment manual for the four premium data tools (orbitpay_token_supplies, orbitpay_crosschain_history, orbitpay_economics_series, orbitpay_tags_export). Those four are priced at 0.0005 USDT per call for up to 100 rows, plus 0.0005 USDT per further 100 rows, drawn from prepaid wallet credit. To pay: sign the message "orbitwan-api <unix_seconds>" with EIP-191 personal_sign using your paying wallet, then send X-Payer (your address), X-Timestamp (the unix_seconds you signed), and X-Signature (the signature) with the call. Per-request alternative: their HTTP routes under https://orbitwan.io/idx speak standard x402 (scheme exact, Base USDC, 0.01 per request, both v1 X-PAYMENT and v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE wires); any x402-fetch or @x402/fetch client pays with no OrbitPay onboarding. Called unauthenticated, or with no wallet credit yet, those four return this manual instead of data.
